trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Marcus to fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload. Sam to confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices by adding it to the regression run. Fixed and verified by Wednesday.

trello.name: Implement offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Elena to build the backend sync API endpoint (client sends last-synced timestamp, gets delta of created, updated, deleted notes; conflict resolution is last-write-wins). Marcus to implement the client side: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: open app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, reconcile when back online with no data loss. Marcus to write acceptance criteria into the ticket. Elena to have sync API in review before she is out on the 17th and 18th.

trello.name: Migrate CI to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam to migrate pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Finish test and release pipelines, keep nightly build schedule, and run both systems in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena to add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that. Add a metrics counter to see who's hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update consent screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus to update the privacy policy screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. Get new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. Nothing pre-checked. Must be in the August 20 release as it is a launch blocker.

trello.name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Sam to write regression tests for the payments flow: purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
